full_page.content:
1946, December 1
The following is the faithful transcription of the handwritten original message on a Seraphic Mass Association Card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
V. Sister - for God's holy Guidance
December 1st, 1946 God bless you -- Suzanne - Sr. Keep courage -- Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Requested by Mother
God condescends to use our powers If we don't spoil His plans by ours (by) Rt. Rev E'd F. Casey on back God bless you Suzanne Molloy Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in the Possession of : Sister Suzanne Molloy, I.H.M. 610 West Elm Avenue Monroe, MI. 48161
